documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Spunweb Nonwoven reported strong financial growth for FY26, with consolidated revenue growing 22.22% year-on-year to Rs 324.48 crores, EBITDA increasing by 39.80% to Rs 55.98 crores, and PAT rising 54.73% to Rs 23.07 crores. Management highlighted the recent commissioning of two production lines and a 6.5 megawatt solar power plant to reduce power costs and support decarbonization. The hygiene sector remains the company's largest vertical, contributing over 50% of revenue. Management emphasized that polypropylene price volatility is passed directly to customers. Spunweb Nonwoven Limited reported its investor presentation for May 2026, highlighting a consolidated revenue growth of 22.22% for Fiscal 2026 and an improvement in EBITDA margin to 17.25%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the hygiene sector remained their largest vertical, contributing over 50% of the revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: The hygiene sector remained our largest vertical, contributing over 50% of the revenue, followed by packaging and medical applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that India would be a much larger market for spunbond fabric used in hygiene products.
demand_outlook.quote: So, I think India would be a much larger market for the category called spunbond, or the fabric that is used into the hygiene production for babies, sanitary pads, and all those applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed robust demand in the Indian hygiene market and dedicated themselves to it.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, what we see is the robust demand into the Indian hygiene market, and we are dedicated to that as of now.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that seasonality in non-woven products is going down day by day due to growing demand for premium products.
demand_outlook.quote: So, earlier in the non-woven sector, there were a seasonality, depending on to the type of the festival or monsoon season, like that, but nowadays, because of the premium product demands grew day by day so, the seasonality is going to minimize day by day

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed increased awareness in the agricultural space with crop/fruit covers, frost covers, and weed mats gaining adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: Crop/fruit covers, frost covers and weed mats gaining adoption

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced the commissioning of a 3.2-meter single S line and a 1.6-meter single S production line.
capex_expansion.quote: We recently commissioned our 3.2-meter single S line and 1.6-meter single S production lines, enhancing our ability to meet rising demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Management commissioned a 6.5 megawatt ground-mounted solar power plant across the group.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our commitment to sustainability and cost efficiency, we have also commissioned 6.5 megawatt of ground-mounted solar power plant across the group, in addition to our rooftop installation.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the combined installed capacity across both entities stands at 39,140 metric tons per annum across seven production lines.
capex_expansion.quote: Together, we operate seven production lines, with a combined install capacity of 39,140 metric tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the newly installed 3.2 Single S and 1.6 Single S lines will give a revenue of approximately 80 to 85 crores on a yearly basis.
capex_expansion.quote: That will give us a revenue of approximately 80 to 85 Crores on a yearly basis.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for FY26 increased by 39.80% to Rs 55.98 crores, with margins expanding 149 basis points to 7.11%.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA increased by 39.80% to 55.98 crores, with the margins expanding 149 basis point to 7.11 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that polypropylene price volatility is passed directly to the customers.
margins_costs.quote: So, basically, with all our customers, we are understanding that all the PP volatility will be passed to the customer and that is directly given to the customer.

orders_capacity.claim: The group installed capacity stands at 39,140 MTPA across 7 lines.
orders_capacity.quote: Group installed capacity: 39,140 MTPA across 7 lines

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that uncertainty in the market still causes polypropylene price hikes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Still, there is uncertainty into the market, so because of that, we are still seeing such kind of hike, but I think once the situation will go down, it will come to the normalisation.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that they aim to reach 80% to 85% capacity utilization on lines 6 and 7 within one and a half years.
management_commitments.quote: So, that would be around one and a half year, one or one and a half year. We tried to make it before that, but to be on a practical side, it would take around one and a half year to reach up to 80% or 85% of the capacity utilization.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will try to maintain revenue growth and slightly improve PAT margins over the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: going forward for, let's say, 1 or 2 years, we can say that we will try to maintain the revenue growth by what we are seeing this year, and we will try to make it slightly higher into the PAT margin in upcoming one to two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
